scope: Actual shipped heart/star checkpoints on CPU with one Torch thread. SDL dummy performs raster drawing and flip calls; no native display, compositor, vsync, event handling or FPS pacing is measured. Baseline refreshes exact stats every frame as in its run(); current UI refreshes them inside draw(). No action effects are active. Layouts use the same window dimensions but may use different board sizes. Model loading and warmup are excluded; trial order alternates.
publication_note: Only repository-relative model paths and hash-comparison verdicts are exported; raw fingerprints remain internal to the measurement.
